descriptions.text: Barium sulfate is a metal sulfate with formula BaO4S. Virtually insoluble in water at room temperature, it is mostly used as a component in oil well drilling fluid it occurs naturally as the mineral barite. It has a role as a radioopaque medium. It is an inorganic barium salt, a metal sulfate and a barium salt.

id.extract: Barium sulfat adalah senyawa anorganik dengan rumus kimia BaSO4. Barium sulfat merupakan kristalin putih yang tidak berbau dan tidak dapat larut dalam air.

en.title: Barium sulfate
en.extract: Barium sulfate is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula BaSO4. It is a white crystalline solid that is odorless and insoluble in water. It occurs in nature as the mineral barite, which is the main commercial source of barium and materials prepared from it. Its opaque white appearance and its high density are exploited in its main applications.
